GRADE 6 SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the countries of Eastern Africa on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

2. About Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the position and size of countries in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

3. About Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. use latitudes and longitudes to locate places on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

5. About Main physical features in Eastern Africa in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Main physical features in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Main physical features in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

6. About Main physical features in Eastern Africa around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Main physical features in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Main physical features in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

7. About Main physical features in Eastern Africa in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features,
   B. Learners should ignore Main physical features in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Main physical features in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

9. About Climatic regions in Eastern Africa in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Climatic regions in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

10. About Climatic regions in Eastern Africa around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Climatic regions in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

11. About Climatic regions in Eastern Africa in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain ways in which climate influences human activities in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Climatic regions in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

13. About Vegetation in Eastern Africa in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Vegetation in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Vegetation in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

14. About Vegetation in Eastern Africa around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main types of vegetation,
   B. Learners should ignore Vegetation in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Vegetation in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

15. About Vegetation in Eastern Africa in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Vegetation in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Vegetation in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

17. About Historic Built Environments in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Historic Built Environments completely.
   C. Historic Built Environments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historic Built Environments.

18. About Historic Built Environments around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Historic Built Environments completely.
   C. Historic Built Environments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historic Built Environments.

19. About Historic Built Environments in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate ways of conserving historic built environments in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Historic Built Environments completely.
   C. Historic Built Environments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historic Built Environments.

21. About Language groups in Eastern Africa in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language groups,
   B. Learners should ignore Language groups in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Language groups in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Language groups in Eastern Africa.

22. About Language groups in Eastern Africa around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the reasons for migration of selected language groups into Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Language groups in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Language groups in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Language groups in Eastern Africa.

23. About Language groups in Eastern Africa in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate the movement and settlement of the selected language groups in Eastern Africa on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Language groups in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Language groups in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Language groups in Eastern Africa.

25. About Population distribution in Eastern Africa in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Population distribution in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Population distribution in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population distribution in Eastern Africa.

26. About Population distribution in Eastern Africa around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. locate areas of high and low population density in Eastern Africa on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Population distribution in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Population distribution in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population distribution in Eastern Africa.

27. About Population distribution in Eastern Africa in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Population distribution in Eastern Africa completely.
   C. Population distribution in Eastern Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population distribution in Eastern Africa.

29. About Culture and Social Organisation in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe age-groups and age- sets in African traditional society,
   B. Learners should ignore Culture and Social Organisation completely.
   C. Culture and Social Organisation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Culture and Social Organisation.

30. About Culture and Social Organisation around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the functions of a clan in traditional African society,
   B. Learners should ignore Culture and Social Organisation completely.
   C. Culture and Social Organisation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Culture and Social Organisation.

31. About Culture and Social Organisation in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify aspects of African traditional culture that ought to be preserved,
   B. Learners should ignore Culture and Social Organisation completely.
   C. Culture and Social Organisation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Culture and Social Organisation.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa at the market in your county.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Main physical features in Eastern Africa in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Climatic regions in Eastern Africa in your school compound.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Vegetation in Eastern Africa in your school compound.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Historic Built Environments in your school compound.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Language groups in Eastern Africa in your school compound.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Population distribution in Eastern Africa in your school compound.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Culture and Social Organisation in your school compound.
